question: What is the minimum age required to become a member of the Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25 years.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**__

__
 
• **Article 84:-**

 
 
• It deals with the qualifications for membership of Parliament.
 
• **The minimum age required to become a member of the Lok Sabha is 25 years. **
 
• This is stated in Article 84(b) of the Constitution of India.
 
• In addition to the age requirement, there are a few other qualifications that must be met in order to be eligible to become a member of the Lok Sabha. These include:
 
 
• Being a citizen of India
 
• Not being an undischarged insolvent
 
• Not being of unsound mind
 
• Not being convicted of any criminal offense involving moral turpitude
